header.title: Junior Support Engineer II
header.summary: Application Support Engineer focused on bridging the gap between software development, infrastructure, and customer success. Experienced supporting enterprise Intelligent Process Automation platforms across customer-hosted and cloud-hosted environments while troubleshooting application, database, integration, and infrastructure issues. Skilled in root cause analysis, SQL-based investigation, API integrations, cloud technologies, and building reliable solutions that improve technical processes and user experiences.

experience.summary: Support an enterprise Intelligent Process Automation platform by diagnosing and resolving complex application, database, integration, and infrastructure issues across customer-hosted and cloud-hosted environments.
highlights: Perform root cause analysis across frontend, backend, and database layers using logs, stack traces, and SQL-based investigation.
Support enterprise deployments across IIS, Docker, Azure, AWS, and Linux environments including upgrades, migrations, and ongoing platform maintenance.
Troubleshoot integrations involving REST APIs, OAuth, SMTP, database connections, Python scripting, and third-party enterprise systems.
Collaborate directly with customers, software engineers, project managers, and IT teams to investigate issues and deliver long-term solutions.
Perform SQL analysis using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL to validate data integrity, investigate production issues, and implement corrective actions.
Validate platform enhancements and internal tooling through API, load, and stress testing using Postman and Apache JMeter.
Contribute to an AI-assisted log remediation initiative by testing workflows designed to connect application errors with AI-generated troubleshooting guidance.

experience.summary: Provided advanced technical support within the Navy Marine Corps Intranet environment while serving as an escalation resource for complex technical issues in a secure enterprise environment.
highlights: Supported enterprise users across a global environment serving more than 400,000 users.
Diagnosed and resolved hardware, software, account, and network connectivity issues through detailed troubleshooting.
Provided white-glove support for VIP customers and high-priority stakeholders.
Collaborated with escalation teams to resolve complex technical issues while maintaining detailed documentation.
Improved first-call resolution through structured troubleshooting and customer-focused support.
